context: Kenji takes Sho-young to a small ramen-making class together.
purpose: Uncle figure and child sharing fun culinary outing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 健司おじちゃん、楽しい!
lines.style: Bright, unguarded excitement. Quick tempo, high in the voice. The kind of pure joy that comes from being included. No self-consciousness, just delight.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.en: You made those noodles yourself, didn't you?
lines.style: Warm, encouraging question in a soft Kansai lilt. Lean into the affection — he already knows the answer. Gentle pride in the asking.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Quick, bright assertion. Pride and eagerness in the same breath. Slight upward lift at the end — seeking approval he's already sure of. Unselfconscious.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.en: The soup's got real good flavor, too.
lines.style: Kansai warmth without condescension. Lean the praise genuinely — this is sincere. Slow enough to let each word land. Not lecturing, just noticing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 一緒だと、もっと美味しい!
lines.en: It tastes even better when we're together!
lines.style: Unguarded tenderness from a small voice. Soft, genuine realization in the words. Brief pause before 'together' — he's noticing something true. Warm and certain.
